meta.parties: Bagsoobhoy v. The Ceylon Wharfage Co. Ltd

rules.statement: A carrier by trade is governed by the Praetor's Edict 'De Nautis Caponibus et Stabulariis' under Roman Dutch law, and a carrier must show ordinary diligence in case of gratuitous carriage or the skill of an ordinary reasonable carrier in case of paid carriage.
rules.supporting_quote: "A carrier by trade is governed by the Praetor's Edict 'De Nautis Caponibus et Stabulariis' [Digest Bk. IV Tit. 9.]"
